g.title: ACKD_QSP
g.text: Anemia of Chronic Kidney Disease (ACKD) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Nephron loss → REP-cell EPO deficiency + HIF-PHD oxygen sensing + hepcidin-driven functional iron deficiency → impaired erythropoiesis
Pharmacology: ESAs (epoetin / darbepoetin / MPG-epoetin beta) · HIF-PHIs (roxadustat / daprodustat / vadadustat) · oral & IV iron · hepcidin-axis agents
